name: triprolidine
uses: Uses temporarily relieves these symptoms due to hay fever (allergic rhinitis) or other upper respiratory allergies: runny nose sneezing itching of the nose or throat itchy, watery eyes
otcwarn: Do not exceed recommended dosage. Ask a doctor before use if the child has a breathing problem such as emphysema or chronic bronchitis glaucoma Ask a doctor before use if the child is taking sedatives or tranquilizers Stop use and ask a doctor if new symptoms occur
